$$

$$
\begin{aligned}y(0) &=\left(0\right)^{2} + 1 \\ &=1\end{aligned}
$$

$$
\begin{gathered}a+b+c \\ =\left(1\right)+\left(- \sqrt{3}\right)+\left(- \frac{\sqrt{2}}{2}\right) \\ =- \sqrt{3} - \frac{\sqrt{2}}{2} + 1\end{gathered}
